name: Ascendant faction (proof of concept)
author: Sanctuary Mods
description: A fourth faction, picked from the lobby's faction dropdown, with two commanders to choose from. It borrows EDA's models: commander, T1 engineer, land factory, alloy extractor, energy generator, a T1 raider and a heavier, slower T1 tank. Proves a new faction can be added by a mod with no C#; not balanced.
